t: 第一次已知提及立陶宛是在奎德林堡修道院的编年史中。
te: First known mention of Lithuania, in the annals of the monastery of Quedlinburg.
dz: 第一次已知提及立陶宛是在奎德林堡修道院的编年史中。
de: First known mention of Lithuania, in the annals of the monastery of Quedlinburg.

t: 由梅卢斯在巴里起义所领导的伦巴底部队出击意大利的拜占庭卡特帕纳特.
te: Lombard forces led by Melus revolt in Bari against the Byzantine Catepanate of Italy.
dz: 伦巴底革命:由梅卢斯在巴里起义所领导的伦巴底部队出击意大利的拜占庭卡特帕纳特.
de: Lombard Revolt: Lombard forces led by Melus revolt in Bari against the Byzantine Catepanate of Italy.

t: 教皇塞尔吉乌斯四世成为第 142 任教皇，接替教皇约翰十八世。
te: Pope Sergius IV becomes the 142nd pope, succeeding Pope John XVIII.
dz: 教皇塞尔吉乌斯四世成为第 142 任教皇，接替教皇约翰十八世。
de: Pope Sergius IV becomes the 142nd pope, succeeding Pope John XVIII.

t: 美因茨大教堂因起火而遭到大面积破坏,该建筑在落成当天被摧毁.
te: Mainz Cathedral suffers extensive damage from a fire, which destroys the building on the day of its inauguration.
dz: 美因茨大教堂因起火而遭到大面积破坏,该建筑在落成当天被摧毁.
de: Mainz Cathedral suffers extensive damage from a fire, which destroys the building on the day of its inauguration.

t: 圣塞普尔教堂是耶路撒冷的一座基督教教堂,被法蒂米德哈里发阿尔-哈基姆(英语:Al-Hakim …
te: The Church of the Holy Sepulchre, a Christian church in Jerusalem, is completely destroyed by the Fatimid caliph Al-Hak…
dz: 圣塞普尔教堂是耶路撒冷的一座基督教教堂,被法蒂米德哈里发阿尔-哈基姆(英语:Al-Hakim Bi-Amr Allah)所完全摧毁,后者将教堂的地基砍入了地基.
de: The Church of the Holy Sepulchre, a Christian church in Jerusalem, is completely destroyed by the Fatimid caliph Al-Hakim bi-Amr Allah, who hacks the Church's foundations down to bedrock.

t: 由苏莱曼·伊本·哈克姆所率领的柏柏尔部队在克兰提什战役中击败了科尔多瓦的乌迈亚德哈里发穆罕默德…
te: Berber forces led by Sulayman ibn al-Hakam defeat the Umayyad caliph Muhammad II of Córdoba in the Battle of Qantish.
dz: 由苏莱曼·伊本·哈克姆所率领的柏柏尔部队在克兰提什战役中击败了科尔多瓦的乌迈亚德哈里发穆罕默德二世.
de: Berber forces led by Sulayman ibn al-Hakam defeat the Umayyad caliph Muhammad II of Córdoba in the Battle of Qantish.
